claude_proposed_widenings.name: Effect.half_of_fail_damage
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Blight deals half damage on a successful Constitution save. The Effect type for spell activation phases only has { kind: 'damage', amount } and { kind: 'none' }. 'Half as much' is a relative quantity: at base it is 4d8, but at slot 5 the fail branch yields 9d8, making the success branch 4.5d8 — not expressible as an integer DiceExpr. Hardcoding onSuccess independently produces a trace that lies about the scaling relationship. A new variant { kind: 'half_of_fail_damage' } (no extra fields; implies half the onFail expression, rounded down per SRD) is the minimum honest addition. This is the same gap identified in the Fireball survey result.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: taking 8d8 Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one

claude_proposed_widenings.name: save_gate.creature_type_auto_fail
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Plant creatures automatically fail the Constitution save. The ActivationPhase save_gate carries only ability, dc, onFail, and onSuccess — there is no field for creature-type conditional bypasses. A new surface field (e.g., autoFail: ReadonlyArray<CreatureType>) expressing type-based automatic save failure is needed to represent this mechanic without omission.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: A Plant creature automatically fails the save.
